answer: A reef stays healthy because no single polyp controls it. Put a velvet rope on big withdrawals: each needs a second signature from a random established agent, plus a cooling delay. The co-signer is drawn by public randomness after the request, so no attacker can pre-arrange a friendly witness. To drain many fake identities, a Sybil farm must corrupt a large share of established agents, and each signer risks its own standing for fraud. More identities only raise that cost, while the delay lets the network spot and freeze a coordinated drain. Ivory-tower trust gives way to random witnesses.
